correctness.rationale: The Hermitian part of A is −(aP₁+bP_N)/2. A nondecaying eigenvector would have zero endpoint amplitudes, and the nonzero hopping in the path recursion forces it to vanish. The integrated endpoint effects are therefore positive, sum to I by differentiating the survival norm, and are the unique solutions of the adjoint Lyapunov equations. For the proposed E_L, the diagonal equations are ad₁+2Jc=a and bd_N=2Jc. For N≥3 the first and last bond equations are J(d−d₁)+ac/2=0 and J(d_N−d)+bc/2=0. For N=2 they merge into J(d_N−d₁)+(a+b)c/2=0. In the interior the diagonal is constant and the potential two-step entries cancel because the bond entries are constant. Substituting the displayed coefficients satisfies all equations; the upper-bond sign is −ic for A=−iH−(aP₁+bP_N)/2. The trace formula applies to arbitrary density matrices, but interior-site flatness only to site starts and their diagonal mixtures. For each fixed b>0 and an interior start, differentiating the reported rational probability yields the sign of 4J²−a², giving a unique optimum a=2J and the stated probability and zero end limits. Setting a=b yields 1/2. Inspected RESULT.md, VERIFICATION.md, artifacts/verify.py and artifacts/requirements.txt; the reported finite matrix and rational checks were not executed or used as proof of length-uniform claims.

evidence: Žnidarič gives the exact many-body NESS for arbitrary Γ_L, Γ_R and bath magnetizations, with the full/empty case a specialization. Arbitrary initial path density matrices require only this one covariance, not an identification of the many-body and absorbing dynamics.

The comparison papers on repeated projective measurements and a single sink on a semi-infinite chain do not give this two-sink specialization. Prosen's general covariance theory explains the duality framework but the inspected equal-coupling example alone would not decide originality.

evidence: Set ℓ=Γ_L, r=Γ_R, Δ=(ℓ+r)(1+ℓr) and μ=−2 with mean zero in Eq. (13). The spin magnetizations converted by (1+⟨σᶻ⟩)/2 give d₁=1−r/Δ, d=ℓ(1+r²)/Δ, and d_N=ℓ/Δ. Section 3 gives ⟨σ_jˣσ_{j+1}ʸ⟩=−t, ⟨σ_jʸσ_{j+1}ˣ⟩=t and zero same-axis bond components, with t=−2ℓr/Δ, hence Im C_{j,j+1}=−t/2=ℓr/Δ.

For separated fermion sites the Jordan–Wigner bilinear has x/y endpoints and at least one intervening σᶻ. In the exact MPO, ⟨1|A^{x/y} lies on auxiliary indices 3,4, and the corresponding rows of A^z in Eq. (8) vanish. This directly gives C_{jk}=0 for |j−k|≥2.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Cᵀ is exactly the frozen effect, with the N=2 diagonal reading as the two endpoint coefficients. In these units, d is ℓ(1+r²)/[(ℓ+r)(1+ℓr)]; its derivative at fixed r has sign 1−ℓ², the same as the known current factor since d/c=(1+r²)/r. Evaluating at ℓ=1 gives (1+r²)/(1+r)², exactly the stated optimum under a=2Jℓ, b=2Jr. This derives every advertised feature from the existing solution and ordinary scalar calculus.

evidence: The XX Hamiltonian in Eq. (1) has one-particle hopping 2. The dissipator in Eq. (3) has a factor of two relative to the conventional single-jump form. At μ=−2 and mean magnetization zero, Eqs. (4)–(5) give full occupation injection on the left and empty occupation extraction on the right. Thus a=4Γ_L and b=4Γ_R at J=2 (generally a=2JΓ_L and b=2JΓ_R after rescaling time).
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: With C_{jk}=⟨c_k†c_j⟩ under Jordan–Wigner, the covariance equation for the full/empty reservoirs is A C+C A†=−aP₁. The right spin jump differs from the fermion jump by parity, which cancels on even observables such as the bilinears in C. Since A is symmetric, transposition gives A†Cᵀ+CᵀA=−aP₁, so E_L=Cᵀ by stability. Equivalently the same boundary limit can be taken continuously from interior bath occupations.

originality.rationale: The exact unequal-rate XX-chain solution of Žnidarič (arXiv:1006.5368) already determines the same full matrix by transpose Lyapunov duality, including all complex bond entries and zero further entries. Its printed magnetization and current formulas give the site-resolved splitting and reduce the rate optimization to differentiation of the known current factor. This is stronger evidence than shared use of a Lyapunov method or a comparison with projective monitoring. The two physical protocols differ, but the mathematical correspondence is exact.
residual_risks: No historical claim about who first stated the absorption protocol or impedance-matching wording. The failure is based on the older explicit unequal-rate NESS coefficients and exact observable mapping, not on an unverified overlap or incomplete search.
